sources.title: Monzo Help - Understanding fees for using your Monzo card abroad

brands.evidence: Card spending: no Monzo fee. ... Monzo uses Mastercard’s exchange rate without adding a markup.

client_claims.text: Monzo uses Mastercard’s exchange rate without adding a markup on card spending abroad.
Monzo charges 3% on the amount above your fee-free cash withdrawal allowance.
Free account, not main bank: £400 fee-free in UK and EEA and £200 outside the EEA.
Free account where Monzo is your main bank: unlimited fee-free in UK and EEA, £200 outside the EEA.
Allowances apply over a rolling 30-day period.
Extra plan has unlimited fee-free UK and EEA withdrawals and £200 outside the EEA.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover paid plan withdrawal allowances.

client_claims.text: Plus plan has unlimited fee-free UK and EEA withdrawals and £400 outside the EEA.
client_claims.note: Plus plan is not in the facts, which list Extra, Perks and Max.

client_claims.text: Premium, Perks or Max have unlimited fee-free UK and EEA withdrawals and £600 outside the EEA.
client_claims.note: Facts give no withdrawal allowances for these plans.

client_claims.text: The ATM operator may charge its own fee even within your allowance.
You can check your allowance by tapping the three dots on your account in the Monzo app and selecting Fees and allowances.
